Continue Celebrating 250 Years of America with Discounted Camping Boise, Idaho - Looking for a chance to squeeze in one more summer camping trip before the school season begins? For a limited time, the Idaho Department of Parks and Recreation is offering discounted rates at every state park and the Idaho City Yurts! July 20th, 2026, through August 31st, 2026, all of Idaho’s State Parks and the Idaho City Yurts are offering a 25% discount. Use the discount code A250Camping for camp sites or Yurt250 for the Idaho City Yurts at checkout. The codes must be given at time of checkout for the discount to apply. This is the ultimate opportunity to continue your America 250 celebration in some of the Gem State’s most beautiful areas. This discount is your opportunity to create lasting memories with your family and friends in Idaho’s great outdoors before the summer season ends. These discounts are available from July 20, 2026, through August 31, 2026. Don’t hesitate to book an end-of-season getaway in Idaho’s one-of-a-kind state parks while these deals last. Visit getoutside.idaho.gov or call 888-922-6743 to make your reservation today!
